references.text: Describes how the priests should arrange the pieces of the burnt offering, including the head and the fat, on the wood that is on the altar
Instructions to cut up the burnt offering into pieces and place them on the altar for burning
Moses performs a burnt offering in a similar way during the consecration, where the animal is cut into pieces and burned on the altar
Instructions to cut the ram into pieces and burn the entire animal on the altar as a pleasing aroma to the Lord
The previous verse describes the slaughter of the burnt offering and the sprinkling of the blood, which leads directly to this action
The next verse continues with the washing of the entrails and legs, which are also burned on the altar
